flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/Report/lists/ReportListAN.tsx (tab 'AN Reports', resource validoffencenoticelist), pages/Report/index.tsx, pages/Report/lists/ReportList.tsx, pages/Report/component/ReportSlot.tsx. ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/daily_reports (AnsLetterReconciliationJob: an AN letter report, not converted notices). There is no code for the AN to NOPO conversion or for a report of converted notices
note: Status 'User Story Removed': the verdict stays Removed and nothing is claimed. Similar code: the 'AN Reports' tab in ocmsadminui (ReportListAN.tsx) lists notices with an_flag=Y created since yesterday, with the columns 'Is Converted', 'Ref No', 'Date/Time Received', 'Other Info'. Those columns do not exist in the ocms_valid_offence_notice entity in ocmsadminapi, so they are probably empty; the tab has no export button (ReportListAN.tsx does not pass onExport) and is not a scheduled job. The AN to NOPO conversion itself does not exist (see OCMS10.2). The AnsLetterReconciliationJob builds a daily AN letter reconciliation report, not a report of converted notices. Fit Sebagian is given only to steps that have similar code. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Not claimed (Removed). The AN Reports tab and the AN letter reconciliation job exist, but they are not a report of converted notices, and the AN to NOPO conversion does not exist.

steps.step: The REPCCS AN has been converted to a NOPO by OCMS automatically (precondition)
steps.detail: There is no AN to NOPO conversion (see OCMS10.2): when the AN check is not qualified, the an_flag Y from REPCCS is still written (NoticeRecordHelper.java:591-598); an_flag N is only set for the same vehicle within one batch (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:837-841).

steps.step: OCMS generates a daily report on the notices converted
steps.detail: The AN Reports tab loads a grid of notices with anFlag Y and creDate from PAST(1) to NOW (ReportListAN.tsx:35-40) from the resource validoffencenoticelist (49-54). This is a list of ANs created, not of converted notices; the columns 'Is Converted', 'Ref No', 'Date/Time Received', 'Other Info' (60-71) have no field in the ocms_valid_offence_notice entity (ocmsadminapi) so they are probably empty. It is not a scheduled job; it is just a grid queried when the tab is opened. The AnsLetterReconciliationJob (ocmsadminprivateapi daily_reports) is an AN letter report, not this.

steps.step: The report is routed to the OIC's dashboard
steps.detail: The 'AN Reports' tab (path an_report) is registered in the staff portal Reports page (index.tsx:37-40; ReportList.tsx:185-190) so a logged-in OIC can open it. There is no sending or routing of the report to a specific OIC dashboard, no notification and no dashboard widget; role-based access for this tab cannot verify from repo (server side not checked).

steps.step: The OIC can download the report to see the details of the converted notices
steps.detail: ReportListAN calls ReportSlot without onExport (ReportListAN.tsx:53), while the Export button is only rendered when onExport exists (ReportSlot.tsx:40, 151) and ReportGridBase/Datagrid type3 has no export of its own. So the AN Reports tab has no download, unlike other tabs such as ReportListNoticeFE that have an export.
